defs.doc:
lanczos  the nev lowest eigenpairs of the operator op by thick-restart
    Lanczos with full reorthogonalization. At `krylov` vectors (at most n)
    the basis restarts from the lowest Ritz vectors, half way between nev
    and krylov. A Ritz pair's residual norm is beta * |last component of
    its eigenvector of T|, tested every LOWEST_CHECK_EVERY steps; the run
    stops when the nev lowest are all under tol, or after max_iter products.
    Returns the values and the Ritz vectors [nev, n]
defs.intent: the nev lowest eigenpairs of the operator op by thick-restart Lanczos with full reorthogonalization. At `krylov` vectors (at most n) the basis restarts from the lowest Ritz vectors, half way between nev and krylov. A Ritz pair's residual norm is beta * |last component of its eigenvector of T|, tested every LOWEST_CHECK_EVERY steps; the run stops when the nev lowest are all under tol, or after max_iter products. Returns the values and the Ritz vectors [nev, n]

defs.doc:
Householder reduction of the symmetric matrix held in `V` to tridiagonal
form (diagonal `d`, subdiagonal `e`), accumulating the transformation in
`V`. JAMA's tred2 with `V` stored transposed: where JAMA reads `V[i, j]`
this reads `V[j, i]`, so its inner loops, which run down a column, walk
along a row of the row-major array. The arithmetic is JAMA's, term for
term; only the storage is transposed.
defs.intent: Householder reduction of the symmetric matrix held in `V` to tridiagonal form (diagonal `d`, subdiagonal `e`), accumulating the transformation in `V`. JAMA's tred2 with `V` stored transposed: where JAMA reads `V[i, j]` this reads `V[j, i]`, so its inner loops, which run down a column, walk along a row of the row-major array. The arithmetic is JAMA's, term for term; only the storage is transposed.

defs.doc:
Implicit QL on the tridiagonal (`d`, `e`) from eig_tred2, rotating `V`
(stored transposed, as eig_tred2 leaves it: row `k` is eigenvector `k`).
JAMA's tql2. Returns the largest number of QL steps any one eigenvalue
needed.
defs.intent: Implicit QL on the tridiagonal (`d`, `e`) from eig_tred2, rotating `V` (stored transposed, as eig_tred2 leaves it: row `k` is eigenvector `k`). JAMA's tql2. Returns the largest number of QL steps any one eigenvalue needed.

defs.doc:
Sort the eigenvalues in `d` ascending, moving the columns of `V` with them.
Selection sort: n is at most a few dozen, and a stable, simple order is
what makes the members comparable.

defs.doc:
Cyclic Jacobi on a copy of `A`, pairs in row order (Golub and Van Loan's
cyclic Jacobi). Fills `d` and `V` unsorted; returns the sweep count. A
pair is set to zero without a rotation once it is too small to move an
eigenvalue (Demmel and Veselic's relative test), and the iteration stops
after a sweep that rotates nothing.
defs.intent: Cyclic Jacobi on a copy of `A`, pairs in row order (Golub and Van Loan's cyclic Jacobi). Fills `d` and `V` unsorted; returns the sweep count.
